title: GLSL lowering r2: Phacelle as its own MPL-2.0 file so CultMath.glsl is MIT, notices corrected, iv_exp in the fixture, fixture regenerated, glslang and dxc run
first: Follow-up on cut report cultmath-tapes:cut_report:cut-glsl-lowering.h1 (head 5ae207e8, worktree F:\Projects\CultLib-glsl). Rulings in force: operator-split-phacelle, operator-compiler-downloads, self-exp-measure-in-site. Map: docs/cultmath-interval-ground-cut.md, section 'Pass 3'. First action: rebase hands/cultmath-glsl-lowering onto the head of hands/cultmath-interval-ops after its r2 lands (the base above is r1's head; the report records the real base). Regenerate the GLSL and the fixture on the rebased HLSL before any edit, so the first commit is the regeneration alone and shows what interval-ops r2 changed (cultmath_iv_frustum_ball is new; its fixture family is exact-tolerance geometry).

The split (operator-split-phacelle). Transformation step 1 becomes: each #include is inlined in place, except an include whose file is under its own licence, which is lowered on its own into its own output file. The list of such includes is one table in GlslLowering, SeparateFiles = { "CultMath.Phacelle.hlsl" -> "CultMath.Phacelle.glsl" }, with the reason beside the entry (file-level MPL-2.0). That is an enumerated rule of the lowering, documented as step 1 in design.md; it is not a per-function special case, and nothing else is keyed by name. Lower(root) returns the two texts; Lower(string) stays for the inlined body if that is simpler, but there is one resolver (ReadShaderSource, generalised to accept the include predicate), never a second.

shaders/CultMath.glsl: the provenance line says it is generated from CultMath.hlsl and CultMath.Interval.hlsl, MIT, and that cultmath_phacelle is in CultMath.Phacelle.glsl, to be concatenated after this file by consumers that call it. The dropped include line leaves nothing behind. shaders/CultMath.Phacelle.glsl: its own provenance line (generated from CultMath.Phacelle.hlsl, MPL-2.0, requires CultMath.glsl before it), the MPL-2.0 header and attribution exactly as the HLSL carries them, the CultPhasor struct and cultmath_phacelle, guard CULTMATH_PHACELLE_GLSL. Both files pinned by CommittedGlslEqualsLowering; CULTMATH_WRITE_GLSL=1 writes both.

Pin tests over both files: NoHlslOnlyTokensSurvive runs on each; EveryPublicFunctionIsLowered takes the union of both files' definitions against the HLSL (minus texture samplers) and additionally asserts cultmath_phacelle and CultPhasor appear only in the Phacelle file; a new PhacelleFileCompilesOnlyAfterTheLibrary is not needed, the compile check below proves it.

The fixture (self-exp-measure-in-site). The site measures WebGL2 exp against the fixture, so iv_exp joins it; its C# bits come from the platform exp and differ by OS, so its entry carries tolerance "ulp-bounded, platform exp" and names the OS that generated it. GoldenFixtureMatchesCSharp parses the committed JSON (System.Text.Json, BCL) and compares family by family: text-equal for every family except those whose tolerance names the platform, which compare case by case within 1 ulp and print the maximum observed. One fixture, one writer, one tolerance field already in the format; no second fixture. The phacelle family stays in the fixture; the site's parity harness concatenates both GLSL files for that run (the site ships only CultMath.glsl), say so in design.md.

Notices: packages/cultmath/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md :35-43 lists the MPL-2.0 files as math.Phacelle.cs, CultPhasor.cs, CultMath.Phacelle.hlsl with its Unity copy, and shaders/CultMath.Phacelle.glsl; CultMath.glsl is MIT and says so in its header. The package licence expressions (MIT AND MPL-2.0) do not change: the NuGet still ships the HLSL include. README :36-37 and :44-49 name both GLSL files and when a consumer needs the second. design.md :136-192: step 1 rewritten, the second file, the wrapper runs, the fixture's platform tolerance. Unity ships neither GLSL file.

Compile checks on Starfire (operator-compiler-downloads), one job each, detached with a log, polled in the foreground: tools/get-glslang.ps1 (16.6.0, the pinned SHA already in the script; if the published digest differs, stop and report, do not edit the pin to match); tools/compile-glsl.ps1 gains a -Phacelle switch and runs twice: the MIT-only wrapper over CultMath.glsl calling every function in it, and the full wrapper over both files calling every function including cultmath_phacelle. Negative controls, both must fail: -Body 'float x = lerp(0.0, 1.0, 0.5);' and the MIT-only wrapper with -Body calling cultmath_phacelle (proves Phacelle is not in CultMath.glsl). Then tools/get-dxc.ps1 and dxc -T lib_6_3 -HV 2021 on both HLSL copies, exit 0. The browser-pane WebGL2 probe of r1 is repeated on the two-file wrapper.

Carried from r1 and still out of scope, name them in the report: the fixture's ulp bounds on WebGL2 are measured by the site cut; Stryker is not re-run unless packages/cultmath/src changes in this range (it should not; the lowering lives in tests). Deviations r1 reported that stand: the anchored token regex; the iv_exp absence is now resolved by this revision; the HLSL edits (damp splat, pcg3d order) stay.
